data.content_ref: inline:The claim that separation is unnecessary via Latent Path Diversification (SRC_001) contradicts the 'Blind Spot Correlation' mechanism (SRC_005), because a persona shift cannot purge systemic weight-based biases. This relation is refuted if a persona-shifted single engine demonstrates an error-detection rate statistically indistinguishable from two distinct model architectures on the same task.
